edits.oldText:
## Notes on commits

It is really very important that when you are making commits you should always make sure that you are writing a good commit message, because a good commit message is really very helpful to everyone who reads the history later on, and it is important to be thorough about it at all times.
edits.newText:
## Commit messages

Write a thorough commit message for every commit. The history is read later by people who were
not there; the message must explain the change to them.
